ops.target: title: Post-deploy verify fails while the new Worker is still cold
ops.text: title: Post-deploy verify checks the previous version because the new one is not serving yet

ops.target:
The freshly deployed Worker is cold. Its first request has to load and start the new bundle, takes
longer than the 5 s verify request timeout, and the content check fails. By the next attempt the
Worker is warm. The duration of the failing request was not recorded.
ops.text: Verify started one second after the deploy command returned, while the route still served the previous version: every attempt answered 200 in about 40 ms and `/__version` reported the commit deployed two days earlier (raw:20261021T140212Z-3c9d2e71, issue:fixture-org/menuboard#41).

append_log: Created pattern/verify-runs-before-deploy-is-live (hypothesis) from incident/2026-10-menuboard-verify-red-with-long-timeout and the two verify runs in raw/: the failing requests were fast and served the previous version. Set pattern/verify-fails-on-cold-start to superseded by it; its text is unchanged. Linked the incident to the new pattern. Nothing is confirmed: no deployed red-to-green run of the identity gate exists.
